risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and playing a game, or a photo of the console connected to a TV with a game loading.

risks.risk: Controllers may be non-functional or have battery issues.
risks.proof: A video showing both controllers connecting to the console and responding to button presses.

risks.risk: Console may be a counterfeit or rebranded unit.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the console's serial number and model label, or a photo of the console's boot screen with the model name visible.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified model, lower value

proof_requests: Photo of the console's rear or bottom panel showing the model number and serial number.
Video of the console powering on and booting up, with a game playing.
Video of both controllers connecting and functioning.
Close-up photo of the console's boot screen or model label.
